title: BUGFIX — posting-health: exclude dry-run posts from gate progress count
rationale: posting-health.ts uses posts.length (16 total) but 3 are dry-runs (method: browser-post-dry, batch-browser-dry, dry). Report shows 16/30 gate progress but actual real posts are 13/30. Fix: apply DRY_METHODS filter matching generate-phase1-5-gate.ts so gate progress reflects real TikTok posts only.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/posting-health.ts: add DRY_METHODS constant and filter posts to exclude dry-run entries before counting `posted`.
